entries.note: Seen live as the first row of a history, at the shipper's town. A pickup was booked.
Seen live before and after the pickup request, before the pickup. The freight bill was opened.
Seen live minutes before the pickup. The driver reached the shipper; the freight is not collected yet.
Seen live at the shipper's town.
Seen live at the origin terminal after the pickup. The freight reached the terminal's dock.
Seen live, repeated as the freight leaves the origin terminal and passes towns on the way.
Seen live at the delivering terminal, Daylight's or a partner's.
Seen live at the consignee's town at any point of a shipment, even before the pickup and several times. The consignee needs a delivery appointment; it moves nothing.
Seen live before the delivery, once out of clock order with the delivery run. The delivery appointment was set; it moves nothing.
Seen live at the delivering terminal.
Seen live seconds before the delivery, at the consignee's town. The driver reached the consignee.
Seen live as a row and as the shipment's status in the details, whose delivery time can date a delivery the history does not record.
